Hiring Process - Interview Stages
The interview process at Zorvex Technologies consists of five distinct rounds: initial HR screening, technical round 1, technical round 2, managerial round, and HR round.

Hiring Process - Offer Acceptance
After the final round, offer letters are issued within 3 business days. A candidate has 7 days to accept the offer before it expires.

Hiring Process - Employee Referral Bonus
Employees who refer successful candidates receive an employee referral bonus of 25,000 rupees, paid after the new joiner completes 90 days at Zorvex.

Hiring Process - Pre-Onboarding
HR sends the onboarding checklist and IT asset requisition form two days before the joining date.

HR Documentation - Working Hours and Attendance
Standard working hours at Zorvex Technologies are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday. A grace period of 15 minutes is allowed for morning check-in.

HR Documentation - Hybrid Work Policy
Employees in eligible teams can work remotely up to two days per week with prior manager approval. Core team meeting days require mandatory in-office presence.

HR Documentation - Workplace Code of Conduct
Zorvex maintains a strict zero-tolerance policy against workplace harassment, bullying, or discrimination based on race, gender, religion, or background.

HR Documentation - Performance Appraisal Cycles
Employee performance reviews occur bi-annually in June and December. Appraisals directly determine annual merit increments, bonuses, and promotion tracks.

Leave Policy - Casual Leave
Every employee at Zorvex Technologies gets 12 days of casual leave per year. Casual leave must be applied at least one day in advance.

Leave Policy - Earned Leave
Employees earn 1.5 days of earned leave per month, which is 18 days per year. Up to 30 days of earned leave can be carried forward to the next calendar year.

Leave Policy - Sick Leave
Employees get 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required if sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive days.

Leave Policy - Maternity and Paternity Leave
Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave. Paternity leave is 10 working days and must be taken within 3 months of the child's birth.

Leave Policy - Applying for Leave
Leave must be applied for in the Zorvex PeopleHub portal and approved by the reporting manager. An unapproved absence of more than 3 consecutive days is subject to disciplinary action.

Medical Policy - Group Health Insurance
Zorvex Technologies provides comprehensive group health insurance coverage of up to 500,000 rupees per year for all full-time employees.

Medical Policy - Dependent Coverage
The insurance policy covers the employee, legally married spouse, and up to two dependent children up to the age of 25.

Medical Policy - Cashless Hospitalization
Cashless admission is supported across 6,500 network hospitals nationwide using the digital health card accessible on the Zorvex Benefits app.

Medical Policy - Maternity Cover
The policy covers maternity expenses up to 50,000 rupees for normal delivery and 75,000 rupees for caesarean section. Pre-hospitalization and post-hospitalization medical bills are covered for 30 and 60 days respectively.

RCA Documentation - Incident Classification
Root Cause Analysis (RCA) is mandatory for all P0 and P1 severity incidents affecting Zorvex production services and external customer interfaces.

RCA Documentation - Post-Mortem Timeline
An initial incident summary must be published within 24 hours of outage mitigation. A comprehensive post-mortem report must be completed within 5 business days.

RCA Documentation - The 5-Whys Methodology
Engineers must apply the 5-Whys framework to uncover root systemic vulnerabilities rather than pointing fingers at individual developer mistakes.

RCA Documentation - Preventive Action Items
Every action item identified during the post-mortem must have an assigned engineering owner, a target completion date, and an active Jira issue.

Tech Documentation - Microservice Architecture
All backend microservices at Zorvex Technologies are implemented in Python or Go, containerized using Docker, and orchestrated on managed Kubernetes clusters.

Tech Documentation - Code Review Guidelines
Every pull request requires approval from at least two senior engineers and 100% passing status on automated unit test and security vulnerability scans.

Tech Documentation - Git Branching Strategy
Developers must branch off the main branch using the standard format: feat/JIRA-ID-description or fix/JIRA-ID-description. Direct commits to main are blocked.

Tech Documentation - Observability and Monitoring
All service endpoints must publish Prometheus metrics and structured JSON logs to our centralized Grafana and Loki dashboards.

Travel Expense Policy - Pre-Approval Requirement
All business travel must be formally pre-approved by the department head at least 7 business days prior to departure.

Travel Expense Policy - Domestic Travel Entitlements
Employees traveling domestically are eligible for economy airfare for journeys exceeding 4 hours. Hotel accommodations are capped at 4,000 rupees per night in Tier 1 cities.

Travel Expense Policy - Per Diem Allowance
A daily per diem allowance of 1,200 rupees is granted for meals and local transit. Receipts are not required for per diem claims under the threshold.

Travel Expense Policy - Expense Claim Settlement
Expense reimbursement claims with original GST invoices must be submitted via the Zorvex Finance portal within 15 calendar days of trip conclusion.
